instruction.text: Choose the correct meaning of the words.

b.sound: Sympathy is when you feel sad for someone.
Sympathy is when you cry for someone.
Empathy is when you put yourself in someone else’s shoes and try to understand how they feel.
Empathy is when you ask for someone else’s opinion.
A meaningful difference is one that could play a large role in interacting with other people.
a meaningful difference is one that you understand.
a verbal cue is what someone says that could point to a difference.
a verbal cue is when someone speaks
A physical cue is what someone does with their body that could point to a difference.
A physical cue is when someone becomes angry.
To have situational awareness is to keep in mind facts that could affect the interaction between people
To have situational awareness is to know what a situation is.

instruction.text: What sort of difference is this?

atoms.a: Lenny thinks that Newton is a better scientist than Einstein. David disagrees.
Kiara can run very fast. However, Calvin can run for a longer time.
Zoe thinks broccoli tastes bad. However, it is Sebastian’s favourite food.
Chris is quite competitive and tries his best to win. Ahmad prefers to relax and just enjoy himself.

instruction.text: Read the text and decide which emotion should be shown in the situation.

atoms.a: Nick has been playing with a toy for an hour. Tom would like to play with the toy too. Which emotion should Nick show?

b: ++let Tom have his turn with the toy
++ask Tom whether he can have the toy back when he’s done
feel sad for Tom but keep playing with the toy

instruction.text: Read the text and decide which emotion should be shown in the situation.

atoms.a: George sees an injured bird on the pavement. It can no longer fly because its wing has been hurt. Which emotion should George show?

b: ++bring the bird to an animal shelter
try to imagine what it is like being a bird
sit beside the bird and cry
